cues.en: My friend Sarah has run a small online business out of her living room for twelve years. It's her whole life. She takes it very, very personally.
cues.zh: 我的朋友Sarah在客厅里经营一个小型网店，已经十二年了。这就是她的全部生活。她对这件事看得非常非常重。

cues.en: Last week, one of her clients sent her a 10 page long, scathing email chopping her down, calling her a scam artist, and other vicious personal insults,
cues.zh: 上周，她的一位客户给她发了一封长达10页、措辞尖刻的邮件，把她贬得一文不值，称她是骗子，还夹杂着其他恶毒的人身攻击，

cues.en: saying she was going sue Sarah for everything she's worth as retribution for a mishandled account.
cues.zh: 说她要起诉Sarah，让她倾家荡产，以此报复一个处理失当的账户。

cues.en: Devastated, Sarah turned off her computer and cried.
cues.zh: Sarah崩溃了，关掉电脑哭了起来。

cues.en: She shut off the phones and closed up shop for the day.
cues.zh: 她关掉手机，提前结束了一整天的工作。

cues.en: She spent the whole weekend in bed wondering if she should just give up,
cues.zh: 整个周末她都躺在床上，纠结着自己是不是该彻底放弃，

cues.en: thinking maybe every insult in this client's letter was true, and she's actually no good at what she does even after twelve years.
cues.zh: 琢磨着这位客户信里的每一句羞辱也许都是真的，哪怕做了十二年，自己其实还是根本不行。

cues.en: On Sunday, she spent about five hours, most of the day, carefully addressing every point in this 10 page email.
cues.zh: 周日那天，她花了大概五个小时，几乎是大半天时间，仔细回复了这封长达 10 页的邮件中的每一个痛点。

cues.en: Then she went through the client's website, learning everything about her and offered all kinds of advice and suggestions and connections.
cues.zh: 接着她仔细浏览了客户的网站，摸清了对方的一切，并给出了各种建议、方案和人脉资源。

cues.en: Sarah refunded the client's money plus an additional $50
cues.zh: Sarah退还了客户的钱，还额外给了50美元

cues.en: with gushing deep apologies
cues.zh: 并诚恳地连连道歉

cues.en: for ever having upset someone she was honestly trying to help.
cues.zh: 因为她真心想帮忙，却让对方不高兴了。

cues.en: The next day, she called the client to try to talk through the situation with her.
cues.zh: 第二天，她打电话给客户，想和她好好沟通一下情况。

cues.en: The client cheerfully took her call and said, oh, oh, don't worry about it. I wasn't actually that upset. I was just in a bad mood. I didn't think anyone would read my email anyway.
cues.zh: 客户愉快地接了电话，说：哦，哦，别放在心上。我其实没那么生气。我只是心情不好。我没想到会有人看我的邮件。

cues.en: My friend Valerie was using an online dating service.
cues.zh: 我的朋友 Valerie 之前在用一个交友网站。

cues.en: She was half hearted about it. She just wanted a perfect magic man to sweep her off her feet through divine serendipity.
cues.zh: 她其实没太上心，只想靠命中注定的奇遇，天降一个完美的白马王子来俘获她的心。

cues.en: We were at her computer when I asked her how it's going.
cues.zh: 当时我们正坐在她的电脑前，我问她进展如何。

cues.en: She logged into her account and showed me her inbox.
cues.zh: 她登录了账号，把收件箱展示给我看。

cues.en: There were eight new messages, each one well written, saying what the man liked about her profile, how they have a mutual interest in hiking or that he also speaks German and asking her if she's also been to Berlin or if she's hiked in New Zealand.
cues.zh: 里面有八条新留言，每一条都写得很用心，男士们说着喜欢她资料里的哪些地方、彼此都喜欢徒步、或者自己也会说德语，还问她有没有去过柏林，或是去没去过新西兰徒步。

cues.en: I felt for those guys, each one pouring out his heart, projecting his hopes onto Valerie,
cues.zh: 我同情那些人，每个人都倾诉心声，把自己的希望寄托在瓦莱丽身上，

cues.en: hoping she'll reply with equal enthusiasm,
cues.zh: 希望她能以同样的热情回复，

cues.en: hoping she might be the one who will finally see and appreciate him. She said, losers,
cues.zh: 希望她可能就是那个最终会看见并欣赏他的人。她说，失败者们，

cues.en: I get, like, 10 of these a day. Then she deleted all of them without replying.
cues.zh: 我一天大概收到10封这种信。然后她把它们全删了，一封都没回。

cues.en: When we yell at our car or our coffee machine,
cues.zh: 当我们对着汽车或咖啡机大吼大叫时，

cues.en: it's fine because they're just mechanical appliances.
cues.zh: 这没关系，因为它们只是机械设备。

cues.en: So when we yell at a website or a company using our computer or phone, we forget that it's not an appliance but a person that's affected.
cues.zh: 所以当我们用电脑或手机对着网站或公司大吼大叫时，我们忘了受影响的是人，而不是设备。

cues.en: It's dehumanizing to have thousands of people passing through our computer screens,
cues.zh: 成千上万的人掠过我们的电脑屏幕，这让人变得麻木不仁，

cues.en: so we do things we'd never do if those people were sitting next to us.
cues.zh: 于是我们会做出一些要是对方就坐在身旁、绝不会做的事。

cues.en: It's too overwhelming to remember that at the end of every computer is a real person a lot like you whose birthday was last week, who has three best friends but nobody to spoon at night, and who's personally affected by what you say.
cues.zh: 我们很难时刻记住，每台电脑的另一端都是个和你很像的活生生的人：他可能上周刚过完生日，有三个挚友却无人共枕，并且会切切实实被你的话语所影响。

cues.en: Even if you remember it right now, will you remember it next time you're overwhelmed or perhaps never forget it again?
cues.zh: 就算你此刻记住了，下次被情绪冲昏头脑时还能记得吗？又或者，你能从此铭记在心吗？
